units.source_text: 七段思考的时候，说是肚子痛，离席了两三回。

en.t: While the seventh-dan player was thinking, he said his stomach hurt and left his seat two or three times.

units.source_text: 他不在时，名人说：“真有耐性啊，已经一个多小时了吧。”

en.t: While he was away, the Master said, "He really has patience. It has already been more than an hour, hasn't it?"
